Changed
- Updated Azahar for Cytrus to the latest available version on GitHub

Fixed
- an issue where input via the on-screen buttons and external gamepads would not work in Cytrus
- an issue where audio was handled unnecessarily in Grape causing minor static

Removed
- SDL3 audio output from Cytrus until its fully functional, replaced with CoreAudio as of now
results.description:
Folium is a beautifully designed, high performing multi-system emulator that allows you to play video games from retro consoles and handhelds

-- NOTE --
Folium does not provide any games or system files, these must be provided by the user

Emulation may be slow on older devices depending on the console or handheld emulated
-- NOTE --

Supported Consoles
- ColecoVision
- Game Boy, Game Boy Color
- Game Boy Advance
- Nintendo 3DS, New Nintendo 3DS
- Nintendo DS, Nintendo DSi
- Nintendo Entertainment System
- SEGA Genesis, Mega Drive
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System
- PlayStation 1

Supported Controllers
- Backbone One
- Nintendo Switch Joy-Con
- Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
- PlayStation DualShock 4
- PlayStation 5 DualSense
- Xbox Series S
- Xbox Series X

Folium is in no way affiliated with Nintendo. "Nintendo" and all associated game console and handheld names and game controller names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd

Folium is in no way affiliated with Sony. "PlayStation" and all associated game controller names are registered trademarks of Sony Group Corporation

Folium is in no way affiliated with SEGA. "SEGA" and all associated game console and handheld names are registered trademarks of SEGA Group Corporation

results.releaseNotes:
Added
- a pull-to-refresh gesture that repopulates games across all available systems
- functional left and right analogue sticks for PlayStation 1 emulation, including diagonal movement
- load and save states for ColecoVision, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo and Super Nintendo Entertainment System, and WonderSwan
- a new selection option in Application settings to choose the system shown at launch
- new graphics settings for Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, and Game Boy Color
- new Nintendo DS settings to toggle boot screen skipping and select the console model
- PlayStation 1 emulation support for Ape Escape and Gran Turismo 2
- PlayStation 1 support for CHD, IMG, and ISO formats, with artwork retrieval and caching where available

Changed
- from Avocado to my own fork with much of the code rewritten

Fixed
- a crash in PlayStation 1 emulation when exiting a game or launching a new one immediately after
- an issue where Nintendo 3DS titles were read from file names instead of embedded headers
- a blue tint in the rendered image in SEGA Genesis emulation

Miscellaneous
- replaced Cherry’s base from Gearcoleco with MesenCE and rewrote part of the bridging code
- updated Cytrus to the latest version, adding features and improving performance
